'''Seswenna Hall''' was a large civic center in [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]]. It was built to look similar to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CoD" />

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> the hall was the location of the disastrous [[Eriadu Trade Summit]]. The summit was successfully infiltrated by members of the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] under the direction of their extremist leader [[Havac]] (who himself had clandestinely conspired with [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and Eriadu [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]).<ref name="CoD" />

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Arwen Cohl|Cohl]] and his partner [[Boiny]] were led by Havac to believe that they were immersed in a plot to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Alternatively, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Vergere]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were led by Havac to believe that they were helping to foil that plot (which they viewed as the second such attempt on the Supreme Chancellor's life, the first occurring on Coruscant). But in reality, higher and [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|darker powers]] had carefully orchestrated the ruse (for 'Valorum's assassination' was simply a decoy) and those powers successfully hit the Trade Summit's ''true'' target: killing all but one of the members of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]]. The [[Nute Gunray/Legends|surviving director]] would thereafter serve as a mere pawn in [[Palpatine/Legends|the orchestrators]]' [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]].<ref name="CoD" />
